ideas.children_he: אַחֲרֵי הַמַּבּוּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּרַךְ אֶת נֹחַ וּבָנָיו. הָעוֹלָם מַתְחִיל מֵחָדָשׁ, וּבְנֵי הָאָדָם צְרִיכִים לִדְאֹג לַחַיִּים שֶׁבּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: God blesses Noah and his sons to have many children and fill the earth. He gives them control over animals and allows them to eat animals, not just plants.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים הִתִּיר לֶאֱכֹל בָּשָׂר, אֲבָל קָבַע גְּבוּלוֹת. הַחַיִּים שֶׁל כָּל אָדָם יְקָרִים, וְאָסוּר לִפְגֹּעַ בָּהֶם.
ideas.children_en: There are limits on eating animals: no eating parts that are still alive. Human life is very protected, and killing a person is punishable by death because people are made in God's image.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים הִבְטִיחַ לְנֹחַ וּלְכָל הַיְּצוּרִים שֶׁלֹּא יַשְׁמִיד עוֹד אֶת הָעוֹלָם בְּמַבּוּל. הַבְטָחָה חֲשׁוּבָה נִקְרֵאת בְּרִית.
ideas.children_en: God makes a covenant with Noah, his sons, and all creatures from the ark that He will never again destroy the earth with a flood.

ideas.children_he: הַקֶּשֶׁת בֶּעָנָן מַזְכִּירָה אֶת הַבְטָחַת אֱלֹהִים. לִפְעָמִים סִימָן יָפֶה בַּטֶּבַע יָכוֹל לְהַזְכִּיר לָנוּ תִּקְוָה.
ideas.children_en: The rainbow is a sign of the eternal covenant between God and all living beings. It is honored because it shows God's promise and presence in the world.

ideas.children_he: לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת בְּנֵי נֹחַ הָיוּ מִשְׁפָּחוֹת שֶׁהִתְרַבּוּ. הַסִּפּוּר מַזְכִּיר שֶׁלַּאֲנָשִׁים שׁוֹנִים יֵשׁ שֹׁרֶשׁ מְשֻׁתָּף.
ideas.children_en: It says Ham is the father of Canaan, which is important for the story later. Noah's sons multiplied and spread to fill the earth.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ הִשְׁתַּכֵּר וְנִמְצָא בְּמַצָּב מְבִיךְ. שְׁנַיִם מִבָּנָיו שָׁמְרוּ עַל כְּבוֹדוֹ. כְּשֶׁמִּישֶׁהוּ חַלָּשׁ, כְּדַאי לַעֲזֹר לוֹ וְלֹא לִלְעֹג לוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Noah planted a vineyard and got drunk after the flood. Ham saw him naked and disrespected him, but his brothers covered Noah respectfully. After sobering up, Noah remembered what had happened.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ אָמַר דְּבָרִים קָשִׁים עַל כְּנַעַן וּבֵרַךְ אֶת בָּנָיו הָאֲחֵרִים. הַסִּפּוּר מְלַמֵּד כַּמָּה מִלִּים שֶׁל הוֹרִים יְכוֹלוֹת לְהַשְׁפִּיעַ.
ideas.children_en: Canaan and his descendants will be slaves to Shem and Japheth's descendants. God will enlarge Japheth's land, and God's presence will be with Shem's line. Canaan's slavery continues in history.

ideas.children_he: נֹחַ חַי שָׁנִים רַבּוֹת, וְאַחֲרָיו הִמְשִׁיכוּ בָּנָיו אֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה. כָּל דּוֹר מוֹסִיף פֶּרֶק לַסִּפּוּר שֶׁל הָעוֹלָם.
ideas.children_en: Noah lived 950 years total, 350 after the flood. He had no more children, so all history continues through his three sons from the ark.
